Phase 2 recreations

The kinds of graph in the examples, drawn by ForgeGraph from rescaled synthetic data with the default theme and format. For review with the phase 3 catalog.

Each card lists the GraphSpec settings that differ from the defaults. The theme is the starting look, to be tuned together in phase 3.

polarization

Polarization curves, black benchmark, interior labels (lines with markers, color_by). Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: current_density
  • axis.y.data_column: cell_voltage
  • axis.x.title: Cell Current (mA/cm^2)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: cell
  • benchmark.data_column: cell
  • benchmark.value: Benchmark
  • text.title: Polarization, 60 °C

polarization narrow

The same GraphSpec in an 89 mm format with an 8 pt base font and an auto height: every size scales with the base font. Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: current_density
  • axis.y.data_column: cell_voltage
  • axis.x.title: Cell Current (mA/cm^2)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: cell
  • benchmark.data_column: cell
  • benchmark.value: Benchmark
  • text.title: Polarization, 60 °C
  • format figure.width: 89
  • format figure.height: auto
  • format figure.base_size: 8

screening scatter

Many points, markers only (a scatter plot), one group: no series names needed. Series named by: none.

  • axis.x.data_column: cell_voltage_100ma
  • axis.y.data_column: icorr_ma
  • axis.x.title: Cell Voltage (V @ 100 mA)
  • axis.y.title: Icorr (mA)
  • mark.line.show: False

replicates

Replicates: three cells per ACD, one color per ACD, one line per cell (line_path_by). Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: current_density
  • axis.y.data_column: cell_voltage
  • axis.x.title: Current Density (mA/cm^2)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: acd
  • encoding.detail: cell_id
  • legend.key.title.text: ACD

fuel by size

Color by fuel, line style by cell size: fuels named in the plot, sizes in a style key. Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: current_density
  • axis.y.data_column: cell_voltage
  • axis.x.title: Cell Current (mA/cm^2)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: fuel
  • encoding.line_style: active_area

precipitation loglog

Log-log axes with markers only and unit markup in the axis titles. Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: rate
  • axis.y.data_column: volume_l
  • axis.x.scale: log
  • axis.y.scale: log
  • axis.x.title: ATH Precipitation Rate (mol ATH L^-1 s^-1)
  • axis.y.title: Volume (L)
  • encoding.color: process
  • mark.line.show: False

separator colorbar

A numeric color_by: each point colored by its value, with a color bar. Series named by: none.

  • axis.x.data_column: open_area_pct
  • axis.y.data_column: thickness_um
  • axis.x.title: Open Area (%)
  • axis.y.title: Thickness (µm)
  • encoding.color: max_power
  • legend.color_bar.title.text: Max Power (mW/cm^2)
  • mark.line.show: False

flow sweep wide

Wide data: four y columns, one series each, colored by column name (color_by: column_name). Series named by: direct.

  • axis.x.data_column: flow_lpm
  • axis.y.data_column: ['al_no_header', 'al_5_hole', 'zn_no_header', 'zn_5_hole']
  • axis.x.title: Electrolyte Flow Rate (LPM)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: column_name
  • legend.key.title.text: None

crowded runs

Five nearly identical runs: no interior position clearly belongs to one run, so auto falls back to the legend. At a 12 pt base font: at 18 pt no corner is clear for it. Series named by: key.

  • axis.x.data_column: current_density
  • axis.y.data_column: cell_voltage
  • axis.x.title: Cell Current (mA/cm^2)
  • axis.y.title: Cell Voltage (V)
  • encoding.color: run
  • format figure.base_size: 12
